purpose: Read-only, evidence-based game reverse-engineering and porting triage. No tools are installed or executed.

n64.label: Nintendo 64
n64.notes: Matching C decomp and static recomp are different workflows.

ps1.label: PlayStation 1
ps1.notes: PS-X EXE is identifiable; disc images require their contents to be inspected.

ps2.label: PlayStation 2
ps2.notes: EE/VU, graphics and runtime emulation remain project-specific.

ps3.label: PlayStation 3
ps3.notes: SELF files alone do not identify generation. Recompilation maturity varies by title.

ps4.label: PlayStation 4
ps4.notes: An ELF x86-64 header alone cannot prove PS4; porting often requires compatibility/runtime work.

gamecube.label: GameCube
gamecube.notes: GC disc magic or verified game metadata is needed.

wii.label: Wii
wii.notes: Wii disc magic or verified game metadata is needed.

nds.label: Nintendo DS
nds.notes: NDS filename alone is not enough to prove the platform.

gba.label: Game Boy Advance
gba.notes: GBA filename alone is not enough to prove the platform.

psp.label: PlayStation Portable
psp.notes: PBP is a PSP package, not a verified code image.

windows-pc.label: Windows PC
windows-pc.notes: Windows PE does not identify a particular game engine.

decompdecomp.maturity: N64 recommended; other platforms vary, frequently beta
decompdecomp.note: AI-guided matching decompilation; built-in agents in current releases. Legacy decomp.wtf MCP instructions are obsolete.

decomp.me.note: Compare individual functions, not a turnkey port.

objdiff.note: Compare generated object code against targets.

N64Recomp.note: MIPS static recompilation; graphics, audio, inputs and runtime still need integration.

PSXRecomp.note: PS1 static recompilation ecosystem; not universal game compatibility.

PS2Recomp.note: Requires PS2 EE/VU and graphics/runtime integration.

ps3recomp.note: PS3 static recompilation runtime building blocks; title-specific engineering required.

XenonRecomp.note: PPC-to-native static recompilation; runtime compatibility is separate.

ReXGlue.note: Xbox 360 recompilation runtime/toolkit, including supporting subsystems.

shadPS4.maturity: Emulator/runtime reference, not a game port generator
shadPS4.note: x86-64 PS4 service and graphics compatibility research, not a push-button native port.

matching-decomp.label: Matching decompilation
matching-decomp.description: Recover C/C++ that builds byte-identical code with the original toolchain.
validation: Record original hash, build tag and compiler provenance.
Do not confuse matched code with a native PC port.

static-recomp.label: Static recompilation
static-recomp.description: Translate original machine code to a different host ISA and provide a compatible runtime.
validation: Validate translated CPU behavior and imported functions.
Test graphics, audio, input, timing and runtime services on the target OS.

compatibility-runtime.label: Compatibility runtime
compatibility-runtime.description: Run existing machine code when the host CPU is compatible; implement missing OS, engine and graphics interfaces.
validation: Verify CPU and executable ABI instead of guessing from extension.
Trace real runtime, graphics and shader failures.
Measure frame pacing and check gameplay regression scenes.

triage.label: Needs evidence
triage.description: Cannot responsibly select one engineering strategy from the supplied evidence.
validation: Inspect a verified binary header or specify --platform.
Describe the actual goal: matching source, native PC executable or runtime fixes.
Choose the track explicitly before planning major changes.
